tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background behind panels and the planning grid.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, planning rows, menus.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Planning time grid, table headers, read-only fields.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Compressed night hours (21:00–05:00) on the planning. ink-muted on it passes 5.1:1.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: Second stripe of hatched activities (rest, maintenance, washing), alternating with surface-sunken.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers, grid lines, card borders (decorative, not a control edge).

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects and secondary buttons (3.3:1 light, 3.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (≥ 14:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, times, column headers (≥ 5:1 on all surfaces).

tokens.name: petrol
tokens.usage: Brand and primary colour: primary buttons, links, selection, assigned orders (7.5:1 light, 7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: petrol-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of petrol fills.

tokens.name: on-petrol
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a petrol fill (7.8:1 light, 8.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: petrol-tint
tokens.usage: Planned order bars, selected rows, the dragged-over row. Text on it: ink or petrol (13.5:1 light, 10.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: petrol-remaining
tokens.usage: The part of an order in progress that is still to do; the part already done is petrol. Text on it: on-petrol (5.0:1 light, 4.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: work-other
tokens.usage: Driver activity « autre travail » (loading, waiting at a dock) next to petrol driving time in duty charts. Always with a legend.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Brand accent, used sparingly: the current-time line and its time chip, the ring of the logo. Never a status, never a button.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status: delivered, valid document. Always with a label or icon.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Background of ok badges and delivered bars.

tokens.name: done-tint
tokens.usage: Background of delivered order bars, quieter than ok-tint so the past recedes. ink-muted on it passes 5.2:1.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status: late, document expiring soon. Always with a label or icon.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Body text on warning-tint, for sentences rather than one-word badges (9.4:1 light, 8.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: conflict
tokens.usage: Status: conflict, expired document, error. Always with a label or icon; never alone as the only signal.

tokens.name: conflict-tint
tokens.usage: Background of conflict badges and hatched conflict areas.

tokens.name: conflict-ink
tokens.usage: Titles and text on conflict-tint: conflict banners, resolution panels (7.6:1 light, 7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: chartered
tokens.usage: Status: subcontracted or chartered order.

tokens.name: chartered-tint
tokens.usage: Background of chartered bars and badges.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Application bar and the bulk-action bar. Dark in both themes: it frames the screen and holds the logo.

tokens.name: chrome-line
tokens.usage: Edges and fills of controls on chrome (search field, secondary buttons).

tokens.name: on-chrome
tokens.usage: Text on chrome (16:1).

tokens.name: on-chrome-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and inactive navigation on chrome (7.6:1).

tokens.name: chrome-accent
tokens.usage: Active navigation underline, count pills and the primary action on chrome. Text on it: surface-sunken dark (8.1:1).

families.condensed: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif

styles.name: detail-title
styles.usage: Title of a full-page record (an order, a driver).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One headline figure per card at most (emissions, margin).

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: A key figure in a card: driving time, count, kilometres. Unit in body, ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Affecter la commande à un ensemble disponible.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Mis à jour il y a 2 min

styles.name: bar
styles.usage: Text inside order bars, where width is scarce.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Plates, order references, times, weights: anything compared column to column.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges, between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panel sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins on large screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Controls, chips, unit links, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Order bars, panels, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Order cards in the well, the bulk-action bar, the drag ghost.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges, resource flags and count pills only.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls.

tokens.name: appbar-height
tokens.usage: The application bar (chrome).

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: The toolbar under the application bar, and the planning time header.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: A resource row in the planning: two lines in the header (name, unit links), one bar or two conflict lanes in the track.

tokens.name: group-height
tokens.usage: A family header between resource rows.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: An order bar in a planning row.

tokens.name: lane-height
tokens.usage: Each of the two lanes when two orders of a row overlap (conflict).

tokens.name: resource-column
tokens.usage: Width of the resource column on the left of the planning.

tokens.name: well-width
tokens.usage: Width of the order well panel.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: The detail panel that slides over the planning from the right.

tokens.name: menu-width
tokens.usage: Context menus; sub-menus are 262px.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Right column of a full-page record.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Order cards in the well, with a 1px line ring. Nothing else rests on a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs, the bulk-action bar, a selected order card.

tokens.name: shadow-drag
tokens.usage: An order being dragged onto the planning. Only while dragging.
